scope: Cast1 aquarium benchmark launches through J-8c4c0f882e93. A launch is a verified install of a case; a loss is a case that produced no measurement. Derived from receipts, apk-installations.json, commands.json and the coordinator's process-exit-info.txt; raw logcat stays local.

close-idle-pair1-gpu.note: Also launched without loss by J-49a2f4008d65 (check), J-084b4f52095d and held J-0d2afeba096d.

close-idle-none-gpu.note: Lost to Back reaching the system, not a process death; see incidents.

incidents.exit: ApplicationExitInfo pid=30834 at 18:37:43.828: reason=2 (SIGNALED) status=11 (SIGSEGV), pss=0
incidents.finding: A native SIGSEGV about 1.6 s after the panel Back and about 8 s after launch. Recorded by Android exit-info, captured later by J-8c4c0f882e93; the earlier empty crash buffer did not rule a crash out.

incidents.exit: pidof empty at 16:59:41.9; no exit-info captured by this job and none retained in the later list
incidents.finding: Process gone within 2 s of the panel Back; exit reason not recorded.

incidents.exit: Process still present at 16:01:26.5 and 16:01:42.3; foreground later lost to the launcher during the case
incidents.finding: Not a death at Back. Cause of the foreground loss unknown. The preceding none-case process logged two DPAD_CENTER presses at 16:01:00.7 and 16:01:06.5 that no benchmark command sent.

incidents.exit: No exit record for pid 32381; observation panel-back-system-back
incidents.finding: Capture showed the panel (white 0.638, black 0.353, fill 1.0) yet the engine handled the single Back as a system Back (key code=4 action=1 mask=...), so it did not consider the panel visible. A KEYCODE_WAKEUP from the coordinator's session-wake ran concurrently (22:51:01.730). Why PanelVisible() was false is unproven: the process logcat was parsed by the coordinator and not saved.

summary: Three of seven close-idle-pair1-gpu launches failed. Across the other 44 cast1 launches (24 GPU, 20 CPU) no process died at startup; the only other loss is the J-8c4c0f882e93 Back mis-delivery on close-idle-none-gpu. One pair1 failure (J-da19a5050cff) is a recorded SIGSEGV about 1.6 s after the panel Back. The CPU path has no failures.
